Concept pricing

Two ways to approach it.

Final scope and pricing would be confirmed before production begins.

Booking system + portal$2,600Works alongside the current website.
Website + complete booking system$3,400Custom website, booking, client portal, owner and coach dashboards.
Ongoing costs

The production setup can be designed around free usage levels that should comfortably support The Yoga Garden at its current size. No required monthly hosting or maintenance package is built into this concept. Launch support is included, and future changes can be quoted when they’re actually needed.
